_comment: Alert channels for scheduled mode (--run). One alert per window, only when the cushion gate passes. This Mac hides notification bodies, so the call rides in the banner title; sound is the reliable channel.
_min_conf_override_comment: Set by the user 2026-09-23 to see cheaper, lower-cushion calls. Overrides gate.json's calibrated min_conf (0.85), which the weekly recalibration rewrites; this does not get overwritten. Backtest at 0.70-0.80: won 75.6%, avg ask 75c, EV -1.3c/contract after fees. Delete the key to go back to the calibrated gate.
